contract: Socket.IO outgoing rss_feed_closed: emitted once per closed feed with the closed feed's minified payload to every authenticated socket. Producers are POST /api/feeds/:id/close, deletion of the owning library item, deletion of a collection and removal of an emptied series. A rejected close emits nothing and unauthenticated sockets receive nothing.
exceptions: force is not applicable: the feed event producers (open, close, item/collection deletion) have no force, hard or override mode.

The emptied-series call site (ApiRouter.js:457) shares closeFeedsForEntityIds with the proven item/collection sites and is not separately driven (it needs the last book of a series removed during a scan).

The item-delete scenario also emits item_removed and the collection-delete scenario also emits collection_removed; only rss_feed_closed is asserted here because the other events belong to their own records.

invariants.contract: Every successful close emits exactly one rss_feed_closed whose single argument equals the minified feed (id, entityType, entityId, feedUrl, meta.title, meta.description, meta.preventIndexing, meta.ownerName, meta.ownerEmail) to the root socket and to a non-admin user's socket with identical payloads and to no unauthenticated socket. Closing the same feed twice emits one event (the second close answers 404). Deleting a collection with an open feed and hard-deleting a library item with an open feed each emit rss_feed_closed for that feed. A close by a non-admin (403), without a token (401) or for an unknown id (404) emits nothing.
